blb.text: Finneas is the first to volunteer to join Mabel's party investigating the Calamity Beast incursions at Pondside, and he sets out from Goodhill with Hugs, Gev, Zoraline and Helga.

At the ruins of Pondside the party fights skeletons raised by squirrelfolk necromancers, and at Three Tree City Finneas helps Mabel ask about them before a great wave sweeps the group into the Long River.
On the dandelion shortcut they face a dragon from another plane, and Finneas shoots a copper-wire arrow so that Ral can channel a storm of lightning into it.
The party fights the Direshades in Fountainport's throne room and returns to Goodhill to be welcomed with a parade.
